user.title: Connect your dehumidifier
user.description: Connect your existing AlorAir-Lite account. The vendor API uses unencrypted HTTP: your email, session token, commands and readings are exposed in transit. Your password is RSA-wrapped for login but this does not secure the connection. Home Assistant stores the account password in its configuration; protect your configuration and backups. This unofficial integration supports devices owned by your account. Nothing is re-paired.

data.allow_insecure_http: I accept the vendor’s unencrypted HTTP connection
